phrases: Workers dug up a ten foot stone giant
on a farm in New York.
That was eighteen sixty nine. Crowds paid to see it. It was a fake.
A cigar maker, George Hull, had it carved after a Bible argument.
He buried it on a farm for nearly a year.
P. T. Barnum offered a fortune. Hull said no.
So Barnum made a copy of the fake.
Would you have paid to see it?
